# 分析与评估

## 概述

本章聚焦分析与评估类表达，分为分析词汇、评价表达、定量评估、评估结论四个部分。它帮助读者在解读现象、给出评价和得出结论时都能选对措辞，尤其关注评价的强弱区分与结论的规范表述。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，适合讨论、汇报与写作使用。建议把评价表达与定量、结论句式结合起来学，形成从"分析"到"判断"再到"总结"的完整链条。

## 分析词汇

| 词汇      | 词性 | 含义 | 常用搭配                               |
| --------- | ---- | ---- | -------------------------------------- |
| analyze   | v.   | 分析 | analyze data, analyze the impact       |
| evaluate  | v.   | 评估 | evaluate performance, evaluate options |
| assess    | v.   | 评估 | assess risk, assess the situation      |
| examine   | v.   | 审查 | examine closely, examine the evidence  |
| review    | v.   | 审阅 | review the report, code review         |
| interpret | v.   | 解读 | interpret data, interpret results      |

### 听说例句

> A: Have you analyzed the user feedback from the beta launch? B: Yes, I've reviewed all 500 responses and am evaluating the top three feature requests.

> A: How do you interpret these test results? B: The data suggests a 15% improvement, but we need to examine the edge cases more closely.

### 写作表达

- A thorough analysis of the user data revealed several patterns that were not immediately apparent.
- We assessed the feasibility of each option and evaluated them against our technical constraints.

---

## 评价表达

| 词汇         | 词性 | 含义     | 常用搭配                                 |
| ------------ | ---- | -------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| effective    | adj. | 有效的   | highly effective, cost-effective         |
| efficient    | adj. | 高效的   | time-efficient, resource-efficient       |
| adequate     | adj. | 充分的   | adequate resources, adequate testing     |
| insufficient | adj. | 不充分的 | insufficient data, insufficient coverage |
| optimal      | adj. | 最优的   | optimal solution, optimal performance    |
| suboptimal   | adj. | 不理想的 | suboptimal results, suboptimal approach  |

### 听说例句

> A: Was the testing coverage adequate? B: Honestly, it was insufficient for a release of this scale. We need to aim for optimal coverage next time.

> A: How effective was the new caching strategy? B: Highly effective for read-heavy workloads, but the write performance is still suboptimal.

### 写作表达

- The current approach is cost-effective but may not deliver optimal results under high-concurrency scenarios.
- Insufficient load testing prior to release contributed to the performance issues observed in production.

---

## 定量评估

| 词汇      | 词性  | 含义      | 常用搭配                               |
| --------- | ----- | --------- | -------------------------------------- |
| measure   | v./n. | 衡量/措施 | measure performance, key measure       |
| quantify  | v.    | 量化      | quantify the impact, hard to quantify  |
| estimate  | v./n. | 估计      | rough estimate, estimate the effort    |
| criteria  | n.    | 标准      | evaluation criteria, meet the criteria |
| threshold | n.    | 阈值      | exceed the threshold, set a threshold  |
| baseline  | n.    | 基线      | establish a baseline, above baseline   |

### 听说例句

> A: How do we measure the success of this feature? B: We've set a threshold of 20% improvement over the baseline. If we exceed that, we consider it a success.

> A: Can you estimate the effort for this project? B: Roughly two sprints. But it's hard to quantify until we define the evaluation criteria.

### 写作表达

- The team established clear evaluation criteria to measure the effectiveness of the new onboarding flow.
- Setting a performance baseline before the migration allowed us to quantify the improvements accurately.

---

## 评估结论

| 词汇      | 词性 | 含义      | 常用搭配                                         |
| --------- | ---- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| determine | v.   | 确定      | determine the cause, determine whether           |
| verify    | v.   | 验证      | verify the results, independently verify         |
| confirm   | v.   | 确认      | confirm the findings, confirm that               |
| justify   | v.   | 证明合理  | justify the decision, justify the cost           |
| warrant   | v.   | 保证/值得 | warrant further investigation, warrant attention |
| validate  | v.   | 验证      | validate the approach, validate assumptions      |

### 听说例句

> A: Can we confirm that the fix is working? B: I've verified the results across all test environments. The data validates our approach.

> A: Does this warrant a deeper investigation? B: Yes, the error patterns are unusual enough to justify dedicating a sprint to root cause analysis.

### 写作表达

- The pilot results validate our initial hypothesis and justify proceeding with a full-scale rollout.
- Further investigation is warranted to determine whether the anomaly is a systemic issue or an isolated incident.
